detector.name: surya
reasons: detected lines are 7 character heights tall (lines glued together by columns, pictures or ornament)

non_text: No lines encoded: Gpura has no text for this page and Tesseract's median confidence is 0.22 (below 0.45), so it is treated as a cover, endpaper or plate.
notes: AUTOMATIC, NOT REVIEWED. Coordinates are pixels in the full-resolution scan, origin top-left; bbox = [x, y, w, h].

Line boxes: Surya text-line detector (complex page: detected lines are 7 character heights tall (lines glued together by columns, pictures or ornament)); reading order by XY-cut. Baselines are estimated.

text = Gpura's existing OCR line, aligned to the detected line by fuzzy match against Tesseract (mal+eng, psm 6); text_archive keeps Gpura's original where the corpus encoding rules changed it; match = similarity 0-100.
Encoding rules applied to Gpura's text: NFC; chillu+ZWJ and dot reph -> atomic chillus; NTA (ൻറ, ൻ്റ) -> ന്റ; TTA (ററ) -> റ്റ.
hyphen_end is ESTIMATED from the book's own vocabulary (Gpura's full text) and Malayalam script rules; the print uses no hyphen.
unplaced = Gpura text lines that matched no detected printed line: they may be mis-OCR, reader handwriting, or text that is not on the page.
